workerMissing: Missing plugin file: %1. Close OBS and reinstall the plugin. Do not delete your data folder.
workerInstall: Plugin files are missing or damaged. Close OBS and reinstall the plugin. Do not disable Windows protection.
workerLaunch: Windows could not start the worker. Check the installation and Windows protection history.
workerAccess: Cannot access the data folder or backup. Check permissions and free space. The database was not reset.
workerLocked: Another process is using the database. Close the second OBS instance and reconnect.
workerDatabase: Cannot open the local database or settings. Keep your data folder and diagnostic logs; do not delete them.
workerHung: The worker stopped responding. Recovering the connection.
workerRetryHelp: Use the reconnect button above to retry. Logs: worker-process.log and worker-diagnostic.log in the data folder.
retryingAuth: Twitch is unreachable. Retrying automatically; sign-in is saved.
reauthBody: Twitch rejected the saved sign-in. Auto-shoutouts cannot run until you sign in again. Your people, history and cooldowns are preserved. OBS and your stream continue running.
raidHelp: Raiders take priority, even after an earlier shoutout. Our personal timeout is bypassed; Twitch limits of 2 and 60 minutes remain. Waits at least 20 seconds; another bot shouting out this raid cancels the duplicate.
oneInstance: Use only one active auto-shoutout instance per channel.
setupBotHelp: Connect your broadcaster account in Streamer.bot first. Setup creates a local bridge and a backup of the bot settings.
closeBot: Close Streamer.bot using Exit, then press Set up Streamer.bot again. OBS can stay open.
resetAfterLongCloseHelp: If OBS was closed for more than 60 minutes, the next launch resets cooldowns for the current channel. People and history stay intact. A new chat message is required; Twitch limits still apply.
resetCooldownsConfirm: Reset all plugin cooldowns for the current channel? People and history will be kept. Pending shoutouts will be cancelled: a new chat message is required. Twitch limits cannot be reset.
cooldownsReset: Plugin cooldowns reset. Waiting for new chat messages. People and history were kept.
logoutConfirm: Sign out and pause auto-shoutouts? Your list and history will remain on this computer.
importConfirm: Merge the list and history? A backup will be created first. Auto-shoutouts will be paused. Tokens are not imported.
updateAvailable: Version %1 is available. Open the release page? Close OBS before installing.
upToDate: No newer stable release is available.
alreadyRunning: Another OBS instance is already using this plugin's data.
workerFailed: The local worker is unavailable. Check the installation and restart OBS. Your data is preserved.
diagnostic_help: Sent only after confirmation. Channel name, version, connection state and queue events. No tokens, chat text or people list; event usernames are replaced with identifiers. Only the fermionaplay.win owner can view reports, retained for 30 days.
diagnostic_confirm:
Send this report to fermionaplay.win?
Channel: %1
Period: %2 hours
Events: %3

Channel name, version, state and pseudonymous queue events. No tokens, chat or people database. Only the site owner has access; retained for 30 days. Detailed logs start with this update; earlier history may be incomplete.
diagnostic_sent: Report sent. You can copy its reference:
diagnostic_error: Could not send the report. App data is unchanged. Check your connection and try again later.
diagnostic_channel_required: Set up your Twitch channel first. No channel name is available for this report.
diagnostic_rate_limited: Too many reports. Try again in an hour.
diagnostic_unavailable: Diagnostics are unavailable. Reinstall the latest app version; your database is preserved.
